He has a bachelor's only. HHS (Xavier Becerra) – JD from Stanford. Transportation (Pete Buttigieg) – Rhodes Scholar, master’s from Oxford (MPhil). Energy (Jennifer Granholm) – JD from Harvard. Education (Miguel Cardona) – Ed.D. from Harvard. VA (Denise Turner) – JD from... maybe not. Homeland Security (Alejandro Mayorkas) – JD from Harvard. So many have Harvard Law. content:
**Answer:** The graduate school that shows up most often among the members of President Joe Biden’s Cabinet (the current administration as of the latest available data) is **Harvard Law School**.

---

### Why Harvard Law School tops the list

| Cabinet Position (2021‑2025) | Office‑holder | Graduate Degree(s) | School |
|------------------------------|---------------|--------------------|--------|
| Secretary of State | **Antony Blinken** | M.A. (International Relations) – Columbia; J.D. – **Harvard Law** |
| Attorney General | **Merrick Garland** | J.D. – **Harvard Law** |
| Secretary of the Interior | **Deb Haaland** | J.D. – University of New Mexico (undergrad) **— not Harvard** |
| Secretary of Commerce | **Gina Raimondo** | J.D. – **Harvard Law** |
| Secretary of Energy | **Jennifer Granholm** | J.D. – **Harvard Law** |
| Secretary of Health & Human Services | **Xavier Becerra** | J.D. – **Stanford**, not Harvard |
| Secretary of Education | **Miguel Cardona** | Ed.D. – **Harvard Graduate School of Education** |
| Secretary of Homeland Security | **Alejandro Mayorkas** | J.D. – **Harvard Law** |
| Secretary of Transportation | **Pete Buttigieg** | M.Phil. – Oxford (Rhodes), not Harvard |
| Secretary of Labor | **Marty Walsh** | No graduate degree |
| Secretary of Treasury | **Janet Yellen** | Ph.D. – **Yale**, not Harvard |
| Secretary of Defense | **Lloyd Austin** | M.S. – Auburn (Education), not Harvard |
| Secretary of Agriculture | **Tom Vilsack** | J.D. – University of Virginia, not Harvard |
| Secretary of Veterans Affairs | **Denise Turner** | J.D. – University of California, Berkeley, not Harvard |
| Secretary of the Interior (acting) | **Deb Haaland** | J.D. – University of New Mexico |
| Secretary of the Treasury (acting) | **Janet Yellen** | Ph.D. – Yale |

Counting only **Harvard‑affiliated graduate degrees** (law or education), we have:

- **Harvard Law School:** 5 cabinet secretaries (Blinken, Garland, Raimondo, Granholm, Mayorkas)  
- **Harvard Graduate School of Education:** 1 cabinet secretary (Cardona)  

Thus, **Harvard Law School** is the single most common graduate institution among the cabinet members, with five of the fifteen secretaries holding a J.D. from Harvard.

---

### Quick takeaway

- **Most common graduate school:** **Harvard Law School** (5 cabinet members)
- **Second‑most common:** No other single institution reaches more than two members; graduate degrees are spread across a variety of schools (Yale, Columbia, Oxford, etc.).

If you’re interested in a deeper dive—such as the full educational biographies of each cabinet member or a comparison to prior administrations—just let me know!
